theorem.name: AntiunitaryOrbitAndRetardedRepresentativeSelectionTheorem
theorem.statement: The selected finite gerbe/flavor branch is one antiunitary orbit with q79/F/m1 and q369/F*/m2 representatives. CP-even data agree and CP-odd data conjugate. The selected retarded Z64 kernel and Z7 charge sector choose q79 as the time-oriented representative without observed CP input. Full uniqueness across all admissible MTT carrier geometries remains open pending a global action or measure theorem.
